title: Standard names of builtin types
summary: The types of `sizeof`, a pointer difference and `nullptr` expand to their standard names where those are declared
prose: The editor does not find these names yet when a header declares them, as the standard headers do.

value.wrong: std::size_t, std::ptrdiff_t and std::nullptr_t come from an included header; the editor does not find them there, offering nothing for sizeof and a pointer difference and decltype(nullptr) for nullptr
